title: Climb · verb
subtitle: 「爬／攀登／上升／登上」，究竟是哪一種 climb？
description: 「爬／攀登／上升／登上」，究竟是哪一種 climb？

words.note: 使用者提供。ascend 是 climb 的正式近義詞，表示向上移動或登上較高位置。它比 climb 更書面，也可用於 stairs, mountain, aircraft, smoke 等，不一定暗示手腳並用。
words.example: The hikers began to ascend the ridge before sunrise.

exercises.original: The path begins to climb sharply after the bridge.
exercises.zh: 小徑過橋後開始急劇上升。
exercises.upgrade: ascend · 上升；攀登；登上

options.explanation: path + sharply describes formal upward progression rather than hand-over-hand climbing.
最日常、最口語的向上移動表達。 本題的決定性線索是 a route rising to a higher level；這裡需要的是「正式向上移動」。因此 go up 雖與 climb 有向上語義，但正式程度、攀登難度、是否手腳並用、是否只是跨上較高位置，或是否其實是數值上升並不最吻合。
強調成功攀上高、陡或具挑戰性的表面／障礙。 本題的決定性線索是 a route rising to a higher level；這裡需要的是「正式向上移動」。因此 scale 雖與 climb 有向上語義，但正式程度、攀登難度、是否手腳並用、是否只是跨上較高位置，或是否其實是數值上升並不最吻合。

words.example: The team successfully scaled the north face of the mountain.

options.explanation: ropes + fixed anchors + cliff make this a technical, difficult ascent.

words.note: 較廣。rise 可改寫 climb 的非人類、非攀爬義，特別是 prices, temperatures, numbers, smoke, altitude 等逐步向上。它不是身體攀爬的同義詞。
words.example: Temperatures are expected to rise during the afternoon.

falseSynonyms.zh: ascend 較正式，也可指飛機、道路、樓梯向上；climb 更日常，也更容易有實際攀爬感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The aircraft ascended through the clouds. We climbed the hill.

falseSynonyms.zh: go up 最口語、最廣；climb 更容易暗示斜坡、樓梯或需要努力的向上移動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We went up to the second floor. We climbed the steep path.

falseSynonyms.zh: scale 通常暗示高、陡、困難，而且往往表示成功攀上；普通樓梯不自然用 scale。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They scaled the cliff. They climbed the stairs.

falseSynonyms.zh: mount 常是跨上／登上平台、台階、馬匹；不表示長距離山路攀登。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She mounted the horse. She climbed the mountain.

falseSynonyms.zh: scramble up 需要崎嶇、陡峭、手腳並用或不穩；平常走樓梯不用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We scrambled up the rocky bank. We climbed the stairs.

falseSynonyms.zh: clamber up 強調笨拙和費力；climb 本身不帶 awkwardness。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He clambered up the embankment. He climbed the ladder.

falseSynonyms.zh: rise 適合 prices, temperature, numbers 等水平增加；人爬山不能一般改成 rise。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Prices rose steadily. The hikers climbed the ridge.

falseSynonyms.zh: crawl 表示用手膝／四肢在低處移動；可以向上爬，但核心不是高度增加。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The child crawled across the floor. The climber climbed the wall.
